core_principles: Aggressive Urban Tension: High contrast, oversized typography, and sharp, unapologetic edges. No soft radii.
Neon on Void: Deepest blacks contrasted with aggressive neon accents (Acid Yellow/Hot Pink) mimicking street graffiti and night culture.
Brutalist Functionalism: Navigation and cart/checkout flows must be dead-simple and structured, contrasting with the chaotic, immersive marketing pages.

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' punch: Radical weight contrast. Ultra-heavy 'Anton' for headings to scream the brand identity, paired with clean, geometric 'Outfit' for readable UI and data.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.marketing_cards: border-2 border-zinc-800 bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:border-zinc-500 transition-colors duration-300
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons_primary: bg-[#DFFF00] text-[#050505] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#BADD00] border-2 border-[#DFFF00] hover:translate-y-[-2px] hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#FF007F] transition-all
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons_secondary: bg-transparent text-white border-2 border-zinc-700 hover:border-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#050505]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-800

components.navigation: Minimalist header. Sticky with heavy glassmorphism. Use large typographic logo 'UNDER STREET'.
components.hero: Full viewport height. Gritty background image overlayed with bg-black/50. Giant typography interacting with the model image. Asymmetrical layout.
components.product_grid: Bento-style or stark masonry grid. Large product images. Hover reveals alternative image or quick 'Add to Cart' neon button.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Giant outline text 'UNDER STREET // NEW DROPS //' running across the screen for kinetic texture.
components.checkout_mock: Clean, highly functional form. Shadcn Input/Select with rounded-none and focus:ring-[#DFFF00]. MercadoPago mock is a high-contrast modal or section.
components.admin_dashboard: Control room aesthetic. Dense data. Recharts for stats with #DFFF00 and #FF007F accents. Shadcn tables.

hero_main.description: Woman in sunglasses at night with neon lights - Main landing page hero model.

hero_texture.description: Graffiti wall - Use as atmospheric background with low opacity behind hero/sections.

product_hoodie.description: Man in black hoodie - Main hoodie product image.

product_pants.description: Streetwear cargo pants with chain accessory - Main pants product image.

product_caps.description: Black cap - Main cap/accessory product image.

model_lookbook.description: Punk/streetwear model against graffiti wall - Use for category banners or about section.

accessibility_and_interactions.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#DFFF00] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#050505]
accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: Hard shadows that appear on hover (brutalist style), e.g., hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#DFFF00]
accessibility_and_interactions.animations: Snappy, fast transitions. Use Framer Motion for entrance staggers on product grids (duration 0.3s, ease-out). No slow fades.
accessibility_and_interactions.testing: All buttons, links, form inputs, and checkout interactions must include descriptive data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI (Customized heavily to remove default Vercel aesthetic).
Strip all border-radius from Shadcn components; use rounded-none everywhere to enforce the brutalist streetwear look.
Use 'Anton' font for all major headings and uppercase labels. Ensure tracking-tight is applied.
Implement a mock Google OAuth login modal with high contrast dark styling.
For the MercadoPago mock checkout flow, build a clean, dense form that looks like a high-end technical interface.
The admin dashboard must feel like an underground 'control room'. Use dense tables, monospaced numbers, and sharp borders.
Apply `data-testid` universally across all interactive elements, products, and admin actions for testing.
